decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): [ev-5744baed396c] and the linked PR [ev-648300e10520] say the subject is the Go toolchain used to build cert-manager 1.18.0, and that it changed to v1.24.4 through `make upgrade-klone`. The PR adds that this picks up Go's security fixes to crypto/x509, net/http and os. [ev-721840e4a65d] shows that only build tooling files changed (klone.yaml, make/_shared/tools/00_mod.mk), so applicability is unconditional: every 1.18.0 build ships with this toolchain, and no environment setting decides exposure. The previous Go version is not stated, but a version bump with a known new value is concrete enough to write the change and applicability aspects.
